_comment: Stall-watchdog registry. Each watch: {id, path (file or glob), maxQuietMin, note, paused?}. The watchdog (scripts/stall-watchdog.mjs) alarms and exits when the newest mtime behind a path is older than its quiet budget — progress staleness, not process existence. Seating a new long-running lane REQUIRES adding its progress artifact here; a runner without a registered watch is not dispatched (AGENT_CONTRACT section 5).

watches.note: planner-run L24 metros pass; Harris plan can be legitimately quiet ~35min, alarm at 45
drain custodian per-county progress; largest counties measured ~30min
detached heartbeat loop per L16B dispatch; unpause when L16B seats
